title: Under the pad
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Day three. The envelope goes under the pad. Its corner sticks out. Wood draws all day on top of it. Every strip that day has a corner of envelope under it, and the strip shows the corner.

panels.composition: The desk. WOOD sliding the envelope under the pad. BARNABY on the bed, watching it go.

image.prompt: a young man sliding a thick envelope under a drawing pad on a desk while a small dog watches from a bed, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pad. The envelope's corner sticking out at the top left. PORTLAND, a third of it.

image.prompt: close on a drawing pad with the corner of an envelope protruding from beneath it, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood's pen moving on the pad. The corner. Both in the frame.

image.prompt: close on a pen drawing on a pad with an envelope's corner visible beneath the pad's edge, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Night. The lamp off. The pad. The corner. The strip draws the corner in the dark, which it can't, and does.

image.prompt: a desk in darkness with a drawing pad and the pale corner of an envelope beneath it, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Day three. The corner in every panel. Drawn in the dark.
